Name: Personal Combat Drone Redux
Author: klatuprism
Description:
After a couple of  years of maintaining the unofficial version of cotboy's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4507]Personal Combat Drone[/url]  (hidden away in the Stardew forums) I figured it was time to bring out to a larger audience.

Sometimes you just want to mine, or fish in the sewers in peace. This drone will keep you protected from enemies by blasting them before they
can get too close.  I've also had feedback for users with Carpal Tunnel Syndrome that this mod makes traversing the mines a lot easier on the hand.

I tested the re-texture [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9239]Navi (from Legend of Zelda) for Personal Combat Drone - RETEXTURE[/url] and they are still compatible.

It even kills armoured bugs!

[size=3][b]config.json options:[/b][/size]
"Active": true, ﻿ ﻿ ﻿   // Default state on day start.
"KeyboardShortcut": "F7", ﻿     // Keyboard shortcut to toggle the drone on and off.
"RotationSpeed": 2, ﻿ ﻿       // How fast the drone rotates around you, in seconds.
"Damage": -1, ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿// Damage the projectile does, -1 = one hit KO.
"ProjectileVelocity": 16, ﻿ ﻿// How fast the projectile moves. Smaller is slower and has a higher chance of missing.
"DroneRadius": 80 ﻿ ﻿ ﻿// how large a circle the drone flies

All mod options are configurable with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url].
